PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday MARCH 8, 2018
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French, Commissioners Aleman, Avery, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar
Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of February 8, 2018
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Tentative Tract Map 66204 Time Extension No. 1
Alta Community Association, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to Tentative Tract Map 66204 for the subdivision of approximately three acres into 10 single-family residential lots. The project site is located on the north side of Avenue R-8 between Segovia Way and 57th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-007 approving Tentative Tract Map 66204 Time Extension 1 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 02-08 Time Extension No. 1
Md7, LLC, Applicant
A request for approval of a 10-year time extension for a previously approved major telecommunications facility located at 39700 30th Street West (Marie Kerr Park).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission consider a request for a 10-year time extension for a previously approved major telecommunications facility located at 39700 30th Street West (Marie Kerr Park) and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Tentative Tract Map 74927
Antelope Valley Fairway Estates, LLC, Applicant
A request to subdivide approximately seven acres into 20 lots for the purpose of constructing 20 detached single-family residences. The project site is located approximately 850 feet west of Division Street and approximately 1,200 feet south of Avenue O.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-008 approving Tentative Tract Map 74927 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program finding that the project will not result in a significant impact on the environment. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8C
8D. Tentative Tract Map 74955
Nona Palmdale, LLC, Applicant
The applicant is requesting to subdivide three contiguous parcels totaling approximately 41 acres into 154 lots for the purpose of constructing 148 detached single-family residences and one detention basin (spanning six lots). The project site is located at the southwest corner of the future alignment of Avenue S-8 and 60th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-009 approving Tentative Tract Map 74955 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program finding that the project will not result in a significant impact on the environment. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8D
9. Staff Communications
Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, April 12, 2018, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
